source: Cost for Poor Quality Control-R0-08122025.xlsx (revision R0, 12 Aug 2025)
guidance: Don't count it twice. For example, if C-grade products are going to be reworked, select Rework instead of C-grade.
If lower production rate is caused by reworking, select only Rework, not Lower production rate.
If polymer rate reduction is due to downtime, don't enter it as lower production rate.
Downtime is the total for the finishing lines: both lines down for 24 hours is 48 hours.
notes: Figures are estimates calculated with the workbook's method and are not saved.
The workbook's Rework total excludes its calculated steam and power cost; it is shown separately and not added, as in the workbook.

The workbook looks products up with an approximate-match VLOOKUP on an unsorted table; here the product must match exactly. Product 3142 in the workbook's product list has no standard rate and is not offered.
The workbook converts pounds to metric tonnes with 0.454 in some formulas and 2.2 in others; each formula is reproduced as written.
Prices and margins are the workbook's R0 values and may not reflect current costs.
